sourceRefs.locator: pp. 161–163, especially p. 163 and n. 60. Cyprian of Bordeaux and five further bishops attended both Agde in 506 and Orléans in 511; canon 5 and prisoners.
Opening and attendance paragraphs: 10 July 511 conclusion, the king’s summons, thirty-two bishops and their seven provinces.

summary.de: Bischof von Bordeaux, der bei den Konzilien in Agde 506 und Orléans 511 bezeugt ist.
summary.en: Bishop of Bordeaux attested at both the Council of Agde in 506 and the Council of Orléans in 511.
